# secureaccess_network_object_group (Resource)

This resource manages a Network Object Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_network_object_group" "example" {
  name        = "my_network_object"
  description = "This is my network object group."
  network_object_groups = [
    {
      id = 123456
    }
  ]
  network_objects = [
    {
      id = 123456
    }
  ]
  literals = [
    {
      type  = "network"
      value = "192.168.2.0/24"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Network Object Group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the Network Object Group.
- `literals` (Attributes List) Literal (non-reusable) values of the Network Objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--literals))
- `network_object_groups` (Attributes List) Network Object Groups to be included in this Network Object Group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_object_groups))
- `network_objects` (Attributes List) Network Objects to be included in this Network Object Group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_objects))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--literals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `literals`

Optional:

- `type` (String) Type of the Network Object.
  - Choices: `network`, `host`, `range`, `fqdn`
- `value` (String) Address of the Network Object.


<a id="nestedatt--network_object_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_object_groups`

Optional:

- `id` (Number) ID of the Network Object Group.

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the Network Object Group.


<a id="nestedatt--network_objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_objects`

Optional:

- `id` (Number) ID of the Network Object.

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the Network Object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_network_object_group.example "<id>"
```
